name: PM Internship Scheme (PMIS)
description: Provides 12-month paid internships for young graduates in India's top 500 companies, offering real-life business exposure across diverse professions with a monthly stipend and one-time grant.
eligibility: Candidates aged 21-24 who have completed graduation (or equivalent) and are not in full-time employment or education. Selection weighted for lower-income households.
benefits: 12-month paid internship in top companies with a monthly stipend (₹5,000 government share, DBT) plus a one-time grant of ₹6,000, with insurance coverage under PM Jeevan Jyoti and Suraksha Bima Yojana.
deadline: Check official portal for current application window

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
ministry: Ministry of Electronics & IT (NIC) — DBT Mission
description: Single-window digital portal for central and state scholarship schemes, enabling students to apply, track and receive Direct Benefit Transfer for merit-based and welfare scholarships.
eligibility: Students from Class 1 through PhD depending on the individual scheme; each scheme has its own academic, category and income criteria listed on the portal.
benefits: One application for multiple central and state scholarships, transparent DBT of scholarship amounts directly to the student's bank account, and online status tracking.
deadline: Varies by scheme; typically announced on the portal each academic year

name: PM-YASASVI Top Class School Education Scheme
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT students in Classes 9 to 12, covering school fees and providing an annual allowance to prevent dropout of talented students.
eligibility: OBC/EBC/DNT students studying in Class 9-12 with annual family income up to ₹2.5 lakh; selection via YET entrance test.
benefits: Annual scholarship up to ₹75,000 for Classes 9-10 and up to ₹1.25 lakh for Classes 11-12, covering fees, hostel and academic support.
deadline: Check official portal / NSP for the current cycle

name: PM Vishwakarma
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
description: Support programme for traditional artisans and craftspeople covering 18 trades, offering recognition, skilling, toolkit incentives, credit support and marketing assistance.
eligibility: Indian artisans/craftspeople engaged in one of 18 notified family-based traditional trades, aged 18+; self-employed or working in the informal sector.
benefits: Free skill training with stipend, toolkit e-voucher up to ₹15,000, collateral-free enterprise loans up to ₹3 lakh, transaction incentives and marketing support.
deadline: Rolling registration through CSCs / official portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
description: Flagship skill certification and training scheme that offers short-term training, recognition of prior learning and special projects aligned to industry demand.
eligibility: Indian youth aged 15-45 who are unemployed or school/college dropouts; specific courses may have additional criteria.
benefits: Free industry-aligned skill training, NSQF-aligned skill India certification, placement assistance and recognition of prior learning certificates.
deadline: Enrolment cycles announced by NSDC / Ministry

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
description: Placement-linked skill development programme for rural poor youth, transforming rural youth into an economically independent and globally competitive workforce.
eligibility: Rural youth aged 15-35 from poor households identified under SECC/Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana; relaxation for vulnerable groups.
benefits: Free residential/non-residential training, post-placement support and guaranteed placement in wage employment with career progression.
deadline: Rolling enrolment via State Skill Missions

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
description: Micro-credit facility for urban street vendors to resume and grow their businesses through working capital loans, digital transactions and progression to bigger loans.
eligibility: Street vendors with a certificate of vending or LOU from Urban Local Bodies, engaged in vending in urban areas.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan of ₹10,000, on-time repayment subsidy of 7%, and eligibility for loans up to ₹50,000 and ₹2 lakh.
deadline: Rolling applications via banks / CSCs

name: Startup India Initiative
description: Government's flagship programme to build a strong ecosystem for nurturing innovation and startups, providing tax benefits, funding support and simplified compliance.
eligibility: Entities incorporated as Private Limited Company, LLP or Registered Partnership, less than 10 years old with turnover under ₹100 crore, working on innovation.
benefits: DPIIT recognition, income-tax holiday for 3 years, Fund of Funds access, self-certification for labour/environment laws, IPR fee rebates (80%).
deadline: Rolling applications

name: Stand Up India
description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and one woman entrepreneur per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.
eligibility: SC/ST and women entrepreneurs aged 18+ setting up a new manufacturing, services, trading or agri-allied enterprise.
benefits: Collateral-free composite loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore, margin money support and handholding support for training and credit.
deadline: Rolling applications through banks

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS-2)
description: Promotes apprenticeship training by sharing apprenticeship stipends with establishments, connecting youth with on-the-job training in over 500 trades.
eligibility: Candidates aged 14+ who meet minimum education criteria for the chosen trade; registered through the apprenticeship portal.
benefits: Government shares up to 25% of apprenticeship stipend (max ₹1,500/month), free training, industry-recognized National Apprenticeship Certificate.
deadline: Rolling enrolment on the apprenticeship portal

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
description: Scholarship supporting girl students pursuing technical diploma/degree education, aimed at empowering women through financial assistance for technical studies.
eligibility: Girl students (max 2 per family) admitted to AICTE-approved diploma/degree institutions with annual family income below ₹8 lakh.
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for tuition and other academic expenses for every year of study.
deadline: Check AICTE / NSP announcements each academic year

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Specially-Abled Students
description: Scholarship for differently-abled students pursuing technical education, enabling equal access to diploma and degree programmes in AICTE-approved institutions.
eligibility: Specially-abled students (40%+ disability) admitted to AICTE-approved diploma/degree programmes with family income below ₹8 lakh.
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum covering tuition fees, assistive devices and academic expenses.
deadline: Check AICTE / NSP announcements each academic year

name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme (PMSS)
description: Scholarship for dependent children of ex-servicemen and Coast Guard personnel to pursue professional and technical degree courses in India.
eligibility: Dependent children/widows of ex-servicemen and Coast Guard personnel enrolled in professional degree courses (engineering, medicine, etc.).
benefits: ₹2,500 per month for girls and ₹2,000 per month for boys towards professional course fees, paid annually.
deadline: Apply through DESW portal (current cycle deadlines on site)

name: Unnat Bharat Abhiyan 2.0
description: Programme connecting Higher Education Institutions with villages to work on local development challenges, giving students hands-on rural innovation and research exposure.
eligibility: Students and faculty of participating Higher Education Institutions adopting villages for development projects.
benefits: Real-world problem-solving experience, institute grants for rural technology interventions and recognition for socially relevant projects.
deadline: Through participating institutions

name: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan
description: Integrated scheme for school education from pre-school to Class 12, including support components like textbooks, uniforms and scholarships under one umbrella.
eligibility: School students (pre-school to Class 12) in government and aided schools; component-wise criteria apply.
benefits: Holistic school education support including free textbooks, uniforms, transport allowance and scholarships for eligible students.
deadline: Through school authorities each academic year

name: PM Research Fellowship (PMRF)
description: Fellowship to attract India's best talent for doctoral research in IITs, IISc, NITs and IIEST, supporting cutting-edge technology and science research careers.
eligibility: Graduates/postgraduates from recognized institutions meeting academic criteria (CGPA thresholds) applying for direct PhD or integrated PhD.
benefits: Fellowship of ₹70,000-₹80,000 per month plus ₹2 lakh annual research grant for up to 5 years of PhD research.
deadline: Two cycles per year — check official portal

name: PM MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: Collateral-free micro-credit up to ₹20 lakh for non-corporate, non-farm small business income generation activities across three loan categories.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen (typically 18+) planning income-generating micro-enterprise activity in manufacturing, trading or services.
benefits: Loans up to ₹20 lakh (Shishu ₹50k, Kishore ₹5L, Tarun ₹10L, Tarun Plus ₹20L) without collateral from banks, NBFCs and MFIs.
deadline: Rolling applications through banks / JAM portals

name: DigiLocker
description: Digital document wallet for students to securely store and share academic certificates, marksheets and identity documents issued through DigiLocker-verified issuers.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen with Aadhaar; students get verified academic documents from boards and universities.
benefits: Free, secure lifetime storage of academic documents, anywhere-anytime access and verified digital certificates accepted for admissions and jobs.
deadline: Always available

name: SWAYAM Free Online Courses
description: Government MOOCs platform offering free online courses from Class 9 to post-graduation across engineering, science, humanities and skills, taught by top faculty.
eligibility: Open to all learners; no entry requirements for most courses.
benefits: Free courses with optional certification exams, credit transfer to academic programmes, and courses from IITs, IIMs and top universities.
deadline: New course cycles every semester

name: NEAT 3.0 — National Educational Alliance for Technology
description: Aggregator platform offering EdTech solutions including AI-powered learning, coding platforms and career tools at concessional rates to students through AICTE partnerships.
eligibility: Students of AICTE-approved institutions and other eligible learners registering through the NEAT portal.
benefits: Access to premium EdTech learning tools and courses at significantly discounted or free rates via MoU-backed partnerships.
deadline: Rolling — check partner offerings on the portal

name: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS)
description: One-year apprenticeship training for engineering, technology and non-engineering graduates/diploma holders in industry, managed by Board of Apprenticeship Training.
eligibility: Graduates and diploma holders in engineering, technology, and non-technical streams (arts, science, commerce) registered on the NATS portal.
benefits: Stipend (₹6,000-₹9,000 per month depending on qualification), industry-recognized certificate and real workplace experience.
deadline: Rolling enrolment on the NATS portal

name: PM Gramin Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (PMGDISHA)
description: Digital literacy campaign to make rural households digitally literate, covering basics of computers, internet, digital payments and online government services.
eligibility: One member of every eligible rural household aged 14-60, preferably 14-45.
benefits: Free digital literacy training and certification enabling participation in the digital economy and access to e-governance services.
deadline: Through CSC centres

name: SWAYAM PRABHA DTH Channels
description: 34 DTH TV channels telecasting educational content 24x7 for students who lack internet access, covering school, undergraduate and skill education.
eligibility: Open to all students with DTH access; no registration required.
benefits: Free 24x7 access to curriculum-based and skill-development content across 34 channels in multiple languages.
deadline: Always available

name: Digital India Internship Programme
description: MeitY's internship programme offering students exposure to e-governance and digital India projects, allowing participation in live digital government initiatives.
eligibility: Indian students pursuing UG/PG in engineering, computer applications, law or policy from recognized institutions.
benefits: Stipend (₹10,000 for 8 weeks) and certificate from MeitY with exposure to live digital governance projects.
deadline: Announced periodically on the MeitY internship portal

name: State Scholarship Portals (via myScheme)
description: Aggregated discovery point for state-level scholarships and welfare schemes for students, searchable through the national myScheme platform.
eligibility: Varies by state scheme; most state portals cover students from school to postgraduate level with domicile requirements.
benefits: State-specific financial assistance for education, skill development and entrepreneurship through a single discovery platform.
deadline: Varies by state
